task_name: Small-Index Static Array Interning for Qubits

optimizations: Introduced _FAST_LINE_QUBIT_CACHE static list of 512 elements for fast LineQubit interning
Introduced _FAST_GRID_QUBIT_CACHE static 32x32 array for fast GridQubit interning
Inlined fast-path check on cls is LineQubit and 0 <= x < 512 returning pre-cached instance in O(1)
Inlined fast-path check on cls is GridQubit and 0 <= row < 32 and 0 <= col < 32 returning pre-cached instance in O(1)
Maintained full fallback to WeakValueDictionary _cache for qudits, negative, and large indices
Added comprehensive unit tests covering fast cache hits, out-of-bound fallbacks, and qudits
